F3: b-gauge requires multi-source magnitude diversity; degenerates on single-source constant-rate scans.
F4: Q5b per-RemoteIP fingerprinting needs >=12-contact endpoints; inapplicable to single-contact scan/C&C infrastructure.

F7: Inverted-eta (swarm detection, analog of earthquake swarms) is the correct instrument for scan morphology: AUC ~0.72-0.79 as cluster-density detector.
